text:
Priya: Quick heads-up  two interviewers reported that their feedback disappeared after submitting from the mobile ATS app this morning. got any examples?

Alina - Recruiting Ops: yes, interview int_mob_221 and int_mob_237. recruiter confirmed they saw the confirmation toast but no entry in the debrief list.

Webhook Bot: event=feedback.submitted id=int_mob_221 delivered status=200 payload={}

Emma (People Ops): thanks. that's bad. do we know if it's a UI confirm-only issue or if the webhook actually dropped the payload?

Jon - Eng: I'm looking. initial trace shows mobile client returned 200 from the frontend but the backend return was 500 for the feedback API call. mobile retries are swallowing the 500 and showing toast. grabbing logs now.

Jon - Eng: log snippet: "ERROR feedback-service: null pointer processing answers for interview=int_mob_221". stack points to new validation we merged last night (strict enum check for answer_scale).

Priya: ohhh we merged stricter validation for answer_scale that requires values 1-5. some mobile picks were sending '5+' (from emoji picker).

Alina - Recruiting Ops: panelists might have used the new emoji quick picker. how many rows are affected? recruiters are asking if they need to reach out to candidates/interviewers.

Jon - Eng: running a query: `SELECT feedback_id, interview_id FROM feedback_submissions WHERE status='failed' AND created_at BETWEEN '2024-12-02' AND '2024-12-02 10:00'` shows 14 failed submissions referencing value '5+'.

Emma (People Ops): immediate mitigation: can we add a permissive fallback that maps '5+' -> '5' and accept emoji strings for a short window, then revert after patch? recruiters prefer not to re-request feedback.

Jon - Eng: yes, will push a hotfix to map non-numeric suffixes to numeric values and return 202 on success. will run in staging and then prod. also opening ticket RECR-7788 to revert once clients updated.

Alina - Recruiting Ops: thanks. also can we surface a recruiter note auto-added when we backfill so they know feedback was accepted after mapping? helps audit.

Jon - Eng: staging hotfix applied; sample int_mob_221 now shows feedback persisted with mapped scores and audit note `mapped_answer_scale: "5+" -> "5"`. prepping prod rollout.

Webhook Bot: deploy feedback-compat-mapper v1.0 -> prod succeeded (2024-12-02T10:34:12Z)

Jon - Eng: prod job finished. patched 14 submissions. leaving RECR-7788 to add stricter client validation on mobile and update release notes.

Emma (People Ops): follow-ups: 1) Recruiting Ops to notify interviewers that their feedback is saved (we'll auto-add notes), 2) Product to update mobile client validation to prevent '5+' entry, 3) Eng to add monitoring for feedback-service validation failures. i'll update runbook.

Priya: thanks everyone. will confirm with recruiters and close loop. :white_check_mark:
